title: Study Planner for Exam Prep
description:
Study Planner & Focus Timer is your all-in-one study 
companion to plan exams, track progress, and stay focused.

Prepare smarter for semester finals, school exams, board exams, or competitive tests with simple planning tools.

Features:

📅 Exam Countdown
Add exams and track how many days are left until your big day.

📚 Subject & Chapter Tracker
Organize subjects, add chapters, and mark completed topics.

⏱ Focus Timer
Use study sessions with short and long breaks to improve concentration.

📈 Track Progress
View completed chapters, remaining syllabus, and weekly focus stats.

🔥 Build Streaks
Stay consistent and maintain your daily study routine.

🎯 Set Daily Goals
Customize your study goal and track your focused study time.

📝 Study Smarter
Plan subjects, manage syllabus, and stay organized in one place.

Best for:

✔ School students
✔ College students
✔ Semester exams
✔ Board exams
✔ Competitive exams
✔ Daily study planning

Stay focused. Stay organized. Achieve your goals.

Start planning your exams today.
